svg.title: Layer patterns of GLM-5.2, Mistral Large 4 and GLM-5.3-Flash
svg.desc: One tile per decoder layer. GLM-5.2 has 78 MLA layers with sparse attention; one in four owns an indexer. Mistral Large 4 has 72 MLA layers; 44 own an indexer and nine late layers reuse the KV cache of layer 35. GLM-5.3-Flash has 45 layers: three Kimi Delta Attention layers, then one MLA layer, repeated.
